verses.25:33: وَلَا يَأۡتُونَكَ بِمَثَلٍ إِلَّا جِئۡنَٰكَ بِٱلۡحَقِّ وَأَحۡسَنَ تَفۡسِيرًا

meaning: The root فسر (fasara) means to discover, reveal, or make clear something concealed or obscure, especially a meaning. The more common form, تفسير (tafsīr), often implies a more intensive explanation.
en_note: Manually curated for a Quranic hapax root.
